The page-level absence of the figure is a real state and is covered by page-minimal-fields, where a page with no heading renders no band at all.

single.reason: There is no item count to vary — the figure is one continuous path, always exactly one. The empty-to-many boundary this archetype exists to probe does not exist on this view.

loading.reason: Server-rendered SVG with no fetch and no async boundary. The per-visit redraw replaces an already-correct figure inside a single requestAnimationFrame, so there is no pending state a capture could ever land on.

key-interaction.reason: pointer-events are none and the component binds no handlers — it is ambient decoration. Its only dynamic behaviour is the automatic per-visit redraw, which takes no user action and is demonstrated by the Demo filmstrip rather than by an interaction scenario.

empty.reason: The band is all-or-nothing at the page level: without a heading the route does not render it at all, which page-minimal-fields covers. With a heading it always has content, so a rendered-but-empty band cannot occur.

single.reason: No collection to count. The band is a fixed composition — curve, heading, optional body, optional quote — so the empty-to-many boundary does not apply.

many.reason: No list or repeated element to overflow. The band renders at most one heading, one body and one quote by construction.

loading.reason: Statically rendered at build time with no fetch. The curve it contains redraws in one requestAnimationFrame over an already-correct figure, so nothing is ever pending.

error.reason: No data fetch, no user input, no failure path. empty.reason: The home content entry is required; index.astro throws without it, so a zero-content home cannot occur.

single.reason: Home renders one fixed composition, not a list; there is no item count that could be one.
